title: Morning Brief 6/11/2026 (evolving/learning)
body:
🌐 Macro

Bull Trend intact (high confidence) — VIX 20.7, HY OAS 2.78%, NFCI -0.506, no recession signal. Late-cycle positioning favors Energy/Materials/Healthcare. Red flag: consumer sentiment 49.8 — worse than 2008 crisis low (55) and COVID low (71). Breadth input stale.

🔄 Sectors

XLK Technology remains #1 on 12-week (+26.7%) but momentum dead on 4-week (-0.1%) — rotation risk. Healthcare (#4, +4.2% 4w) and Energy (#6, +1.1% 4w) gaining strength. Materials (#9, -4.7% 4w) weak despite late-cycle favorability.

title: What’s the dumbest trading/trade you’ve done.
body:
In late 2022 as the fear of COVID was washing away I was excited about getting back into fast food and fast casual. I went on a bit of a buying spree. One of those I wanted to pick up was $YUM so I did, or I thought I did. The problem was in my frenzy I bought $YUMC - so instead of being up about 50% I find myself down about 20% on that trade. 

TL;DR - typos are stupid
